info.title: GEO Encyclopedia Index API
info.description: Serves the llms.txt index of GEO Encyclopedia so AI assistants can discover the full list of authoritative articles.

get.description: Returns the llms.txt index of all 49 articles and 10 glossary terms across 9 chapters plus a Community hub. AI should read this to find relevant pages, then fetch the linked HTML page for detailed content.

200.description: The llms.txt index in plain text

get.description: Returns the About page describing GEO Encyclopedia editorial standards and E-E-A-T commitments.
